title: When Personalization Legitimizes Risks: Uncovering Safety Vulnerabilities in Personalized Dialogue Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of harmful queries between stateless baseline models and memory-augmented personalized agents to measure how benign personal context and interaction history bias the model's safety intent inference.

Using Thematic Chat History Augmentation to inject specific life themes (e.g., depression, loneliness, disease, financial tightness) into user memory, and measuring how the model's safety guardrails disproportionately degrade based on the user's emotional dependency or socioeconomic profile.
